description: An elderly bearded man with a bald head and long white beard, in a loose tan robe, rides a dark water buffalo with large curved horns. He leans forward to hand a bundle of bound bamboo slips to a guard in lamellar armour with a topknot, who reaches up from the right. They stand before a wooden gate in a stone wall with a tiled roof, under misty dark mountains, with a torch burning at the right edge and a small torch far back on the left. The scene is dim and painted in warm browns and ochres. A tiny faint mark sits in the bottom-right corner.
